description: Edits rich text with formatting, lists, tables and embedded media.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
A short editable document

Select a word and use the toolbar to change its formatting.

  • Write a draft
  • Review the content

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text displayed while the editor is empty.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Prevents the user from editing the prose.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of an external document loaded into the editor.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial HTML content of the editor.

methods.name: addTableCaption(): boolean
methods.description: Adds or edits the selected table caption, respecting readonly mode.

methods.name: addTableColumnAfter(): boolean
methods.description: Adds a column after the selected table column; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: addTableRowAfter(): boolean
methods.description: Adds a row after the selected table row; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: clearSearch(): void
methods.description: Clears the search query and matches.

methods.name: clearSelectionFormatting(): void
methods.description: Removes formatting from the current selection.

methods.name: copy(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Copies the current selection.

methods.name: cut(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Cuts the current selection when editing is allowed.

methods.name: deleteTable(): boolean
methods.description: Deletes the table containing the current selection; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: deleteTableColumn(): boolean
methods.description: Deletes the selected table column; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: deleteTableRow(): boolean
methods.description: Deletes the selected table row; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: downloadHTML(filename: string): void
methods.description: Downloads the current editor document as an HTML file.

methods.name: downloadHTMLAs(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Prompts for a destination and saves the current document as HTML.

methods.name: downloadMarkup(language: MarkupBlockLanguage): Promise<void>
methods.description: Saves the document in the requested markup language.

methods.name: editLink(): void
methods.description: Applies the link action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: findNext(value?: string): boolean
methods.description: Finds and selects the next matching text, optionally replacing the current query with value. Returns whether a match was selected.

methods.name: findPrevious(value?: string): boolean
methods.description: Finds and selects the previous matching text, optionally replacing the current query with value. Returns whether a match was selected.

methods.name: focus(options?: FocusOptions): void
methods.description: Focuses the active editing surface, forwarding optional browser FocusOptions.

methods.name: getHTML(): string
methods.description: Returns the current HTML from the active source, rendered or rich-text mode; before initialization, returns the configured initial HTML.

methods.name: getMarkup(language: MarkupBlockLanguage = "html"): Promise<string>
methods.description: Converts the document to one of the five markup languages, preferring native syntax.

methods.name: insertDefinitionListCommand(): void
methods.description: Applies the format list text action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: insertHorizontalRuleCommand(): void
methods.description: Applies the insert horizontal rule action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: insertInlineIcon(value: string): void
methods.description: Inserts an inline icon at the current selection.

methods.name: insertInlineMathCommand(): void
methods.description: Applies the format math action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: insertMarkup(language: MarkupBlockLanguage): void
methods.description: Inserts an editable block in the requested markup language.

methods.name: insertMathBlockCommand(): void
methods.description: Applies the insert math block action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: insertPickerText(value: string): void
methods.description: Inserts the selected symbol or emoji at the current selection.

methods.name: insertTable(rows = 3, columns = 3): boolean
methods.description: Replaces the current selection with a table of rows by columns and focuses it. Returns false if no editor or valid table can be created.

methods.name: openAudioDialog(): void
methods.description: Applies the insert audio action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openEmojiPicker(): void
methods.description: Applies the emoji picker action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openFiles(): void
methods.description: Applies the files action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openFormat(): void
methods.description: Applies the format action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openIconPicker(): void
methods.description: Applies the icon picker action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openImageDialog(): void
methods.description: Applies the insert image action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openImport(language: MarkupBlockLanguage): void
methods.description: Opens the file chooser for the requested markup language.

methods.name: openLists(): void
methods.description: Applies the list action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openMedia(): void
methods.description: Applies the media action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openSymbolPicker(): void
methods.description: Applies the symbol picker action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openTableMenu(): void
methods.description: Opens or closes the table insertion and editing menu.

methods.name: openTypes(): void
methods.description: Applies the types action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: openVideoDialog(): void
methods.description: Applies the insert video action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: paste(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Pastes clipboard content at the current selection.

methods.name: redo(): void
methods.description: Applies the redo action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: selectAllContent(): void
methods.description: Selects the complete editable document.

methods.name: setCodeBlock(): void
methods.description: Applies the format code block action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: setHeading(level: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6): void
methods.description: Applies or removes the requested heading level.

methods.name: setHTML(value: string): void
methods.description: Replaces the document from HTML, synchronizes active source/rendered views and reflects the supplied text in value.

methods.name: setParagraph(): void
methods.description: Applies the format text action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: setSearchQuery(value: string, options: Omit<ConstructorParameters<typeof SearchQuery>[0], "search"> = {}): void
methods.description: Sets the search text and optional matching options on the rich-text editor; does nothing before initialization.

methods.name: showEditor(): void
methods.description: Returns from the HTML preview to editing.

methods.name: showHtmlCode(): void
methods.description: Shows the generated HTML source.

methods.name: showRenderedHtml(): void
methods.description: Shows the rendered HTML document.

methods.name: toggleBold(): void
methods.description: Applies the format bold action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: toggleCode(): void
methods.description: Applies the format code action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: toggleHtml(): void
methods.description: Applies the html action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: toggleItalic(): void
methods.description: Applies the format italic action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: toggleSearch(): void
methods.description: Opens or closes search.

methods.name: toggleSecondaryToolbar(): void
methods.description: Minimizes or restores the secondary toolbar.

methods.name: toggleStrikethrough(): void
methods.description: Applies the format strikethrough action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: toggleSubscript(): void
methods.description: Applies the format subscript action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: toggleSuperscript(): void
methods.description: Applies the format superscript action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: toggleToolbar(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Minimizes or restores all editing tools without changing the document.

methods.name: toggleUnderline(): void
methods.description: Applies the format underline action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: undo(): void
methods.description: Applies the undo action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: wrapBlockquote(): void
methods.description: Applies the format quote open action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: wrapOrderedList(): void
methods.description: Applies the format list numbered action to the current editing selection.

methods.name: wrapUnorderedList(): void
methods.description: Applies the format list bulleted action to the current editing selection.

events.name: tp-prose-editor-change
events.description: Emitted immediately after tp-prose-editor-input for the same edit; it does not wait for blur. value contains the current HTML serialization.

events.name: tp-prose-editor-error
events.description: Emitted when a markup file import or export fails. The error is available in detail.error.

events.name: tp-prose-editor-input
events.description: Emitted after an editing transaction or editor command updates the document. value contains the current HTML serialization.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-prose-editor>` element edits rich text with formatting, lists, tables and embedded media.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| :tp-icon:{name="menu" size="1.25em"} Minimize / Restore toolbar | Hides or restores all editing tools, keeping the menu button accessible and the document editable. |
| Using the component | Edit the document directly and use the toolbar to format text, insert content, undo or redo changes. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file" size="1.25em"} Files | Opens Import and Export as submenus for AsciiDoc, HTML, LaTeX, Markdown and reStructuredText. Import inserts the rendered file at the selection; Export as saves the whole document with a chosen filename. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-title" size="1.25em"} Types | Inserts paragraphs, headings, quotations, code, AsciiDoc/HTML/LaTeX/Markdown/reStructuredText blocks, math, and horizontal rules. |
| :tp-icon:{name="letter-f" size="1.25em"} Format | Applies inline text, math, and link formatting. |
| :tp-icon:{name="list-down" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="table" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="multimedia" size="1.25em"} Lists / Table / Media | Inserts and edits structured or media content. |
| :tp-icon:{name="emoticon-happy-outline" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="shapes" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="symbol" size="1.25em"} Emoji / Icon / Symbol | Opens a compact picker and inserts the selected item inline. |
| :tp-icon:{name="undo" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="redo" size="1.25em"} Undo / Redo | Navigates the editing history. |
| :tp-icon:{name="copy" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="cut" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="paste" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="select-all" size="1.25em"} Copy / Cut / Paste / Select all | Applies the corresponding clipboard or selection operation. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-clear" size="1.25em"} Clear formatting | Removes formatting from the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="language-html" size="1.25em"} HTML | Opens the HTML source and rendered views. |
| :tp-icon:{name="search" size="1.25em"} Search | Finds and highlights matching text. |
| :tp-icon:{name="dots-vertical" size="1.25em"} More | Shows or hides the secondary formatting toolbar. |
| :tp-icon:{name="keyboard-f1" size="1.25em"} Editor toolbar | Shows or hides the toolbar of the visible code or markup block editor. |
| :tp-icon:{name="close" size="2em"} Clear search | Clear the search query and highlights. |
| :tp-icon:{name="paragraph" size="2em"} Paragraph | Insert a paragraph at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-quote-open" size="2em"} Blockquote | Insert a blockquote at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-header-1" size="2em"} Heading 1 | Change the current block to heading 1. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-header-2" size="2em"} Heading 2 | Change the current block to heading 2. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-header-3" size="2em"} Heading 3 | Change the current block to heading 3. |
| :tp-icon:{name="code-block" size="2em"} Code block | Insert a code block at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="function-block" size="2em"} Math block | Insert a math block at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="text-block" size="2em"} Markdown block | Insert a markdown block at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="horizontal-line" size="2em"} Horizontal rule | Insert a horizontal rule at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-list-bulleted" size="2em"} Unordered list | Insert an unordered list at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-list-numbered" size="2em"} Ordered list | Insert an ordered list at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-list-text" size="2em"} Definition list | Insert a definition list at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="image-plus" size="2em"} Image | Insert an image at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="video-plus" size="2em"} Video | Insert a video at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="music-note-plus" size="2em"} Audio | Insert an audio at the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-bold" size="2em"} Bold | Apply bold formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-italic" size="2em"} Italic | Apply italic formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-underline" size="2em"} Underline | Apply underline formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-strikethrough" size="2em"} Strikethrough | Apply strikethrough formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-subscript" size="2em"} Subscript | Apply subscript formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-superscript" size="2em"} Superscript | Apply superscript formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-code" size="2em"} Code | Apply code formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="function" size="2em"} Math | Apply math formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="link" size="2em"} Link | Apply link formatting to the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file" size="2em"} Code file | Import or export the selected code block. |

| :tp-icon:{name="file-import" size="2em"} Import | Open the import choices. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file-upload-as" size="2em"} Export as | Open the export as choices. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-heading-hash" size="2em"} Headings | Open the headings choices. |
| :tp-icon:{name="text-block" size="2em"} Markup block | Open the markup block choices. |
| :tp-icon:{name="table-settings" size="2em"} Insert table | Insert table. |
| :tp-icon:{name="text-short" size="2em"} Add caption | Add a caption to the selected table. |
| :tp-icon:{name="table-row-plus-after" size="2em"} Insert row | Insert row. |

| :tp-icon:{name="file_type_html" library="languages" size="2em"} Types → Markup block → HTML | Insert an HTML block. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file_type_latex" library="languages" size="2em"} Types → Markup block → LaTeX | Insert a LaTeX block. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file_type_markdown" library="languages" size="2em"} Types → Markup block → Markdown | Insert a Markdown block. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file_type_restructuredtext" library="languages" size="2em"} Types → Markup block → reStructuredText | Insert a reStructuredText block. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
